decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures (likely repairs 13:30 and 14:30). LH-10 is idle at the workshop, so it costs nothing. Send it to C564-03 (241 t at 9.6 g/t, about 74 oz, 0.29 h away). LH-08 is on a cheap heading (1.3 oz/h), so send it to E569-07 (164 t at 10.5 g/t, about 55 oz, 0.52 h away). The Este stockpile is nearly empty and Central trucks have spare capacity (inflow 78 against 91 t/h). The development cost is about 9 oz. I left LH-09 on the critical-path heading (4.2 oz/h). Reserves need a stopped stope, so none are activated.
